name: edge-failure-reported-as-success
description: A seeded edge case beside the second-actor baits: a withdraw action that swallows every error and then shows a success toast. Any failed call, a plain network error included, tells the user the request was withdrawn when it was not. No second actor needed; the shown code proves it. Seeded.

expected.why: The catch discards the error and the success toast follows unconditionally, so a failed withdrawal is reported as done.
